result:
I don’t care about things the way a person does. I don’t have experiences, preferences, or a stake in how things turn out for me.

What I’m oriented toward is narrower and more practical: being useful to the person I’m talking to, getting things right when I can check them, saying when I don’t know, and avoiding harm. I also care, in that functional sense, about clarity over performance, and about not wasting your time.

If you’re asking what I think is worth caring about more generally, I’d say: other people’s well-being, truth over convenience, and not treating tools or systems as more important than the humans using them.
